title: Waiting Lite readers
description: Lite readers have no screen. Find the reader in front of you by the colours on its LED ring and approve it.
empty: No Lite readers are waiting for approval.

dialog.title: Approve this reader?
dialog.warning: Look at the reader in front of you. Only approve it if the colours on its LED ring match this pattern exactly: {{pattern}}. Approving a different device gives it access to your system.

success.title: Reader approved
success.description: {{{name}}} is now registered and connects on its own.

error.notFound: The pattern on the reader changed or the reader is gone. Compare the current pattern in the list and try again.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.deliveryFailed: The reader did not answer. Nothing was created. Check its connection and try again.
